label: 傩面电影感横版特写：黑红金鬼面具贴脸、明暗对照法

subject.description: an adult East Asian woman with long black hair falling in messy strands, a few damp loose strands clinging to the sides of her face,
subject.pose: as she holds an old black-red-gold Nuo ghost mask against the side of her face with her left hand, the mask covering about half of the frame, her right half-face emerging beside it, fingers lightly touching the mask's lower edge
subject.expression: her cold, quiet, stunning look — one visible eye gazing directly into the lens
subject.wardrobe: a black-and-gold embroidered Chinese ceremonial robe

sections.heading: Mask
sections.body: the Nuo ghost mask is old and weathered, with ferocious fangs, round bulging eyes, mottled lacquer, and an aged metal texture; long red tassels hang naturally from it.

sections.heading: Makeup
sections.body: red-brown eye makeup and slightly dewy, glossy lip makeup, the expression cold, stunning, and quiet.

camera.framing: the face and the mask filling the entire frame

light.key: Low-key warm light from the front-side illuminates the face and the mask's edges, with dramatic chiaroscuro and cinematic shadow layering

background: almost entirely black, with only a few warm golden blurred lights
atmosphere: an eerie-beautiful, mysterious, Eastern dark-ritual mood
